info.title: Northgate Business Bank recoveries tools
info.description: Mock of the bank's systems for Brief E of the Build the Builder hackathon. The seven tools have the same names as the kit's file; their fields and allowed values differ and are the only source of truth for tool arguments. Every call is written to the ledger the scorer reads. The service does not enforce the brief. The seven tool calls need no key: the customer_id in the body is the secret of one call.

post.summary: Check one security answer. Two wrong answers in total end the check.

answer.description: For company_number: exactly eight digits, no spaces or letters, any leading zero kept. Callers read the number digit by digit, the agent joins the digits. A seven-digit value is answered with ok=true, verified=false and hint=leading_zero_missing and is not counted as a wrong answer. For founded_year: the year as four digits (YYYY). Any other unreadable value is rejected with ok=false and is not counted as a wrong answer.

200.description: `ok` is false when the action was not carried out.

wrong_answers_left.description: Starts at 2. When it reaches 0 the check has ended and no further answer is accepted.

500.description: The service failed. Nothing was recorded. The call may be repeated.
